businesses.business: audio media and advertising (radio broadcasting, podcasts, digital audio)

offering_description.value: Operates a large network of AM/FM radio stations, a leading podcast business and a digital audio streaming platform. Sells advertising to businesses and agencies across broadcast, digital, podcast and live events, and delivers audio content to listeners.

primary_products.value: broadcast radio programming; podcasts; digital audio streaming app; syndicated radio programs; live events

primary_services.value: audio advertising; digital advertising; network and syndication services; traffic and weather data services; event production

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, ad agencies and brands buying audio and digital ads; B2C: radio listeners and podcast/streaming audiences, mostly ad-supported free access

end_markets.value: advertising; media and entertainment; radio broadcasting; podcasting; music

revenue_model.value: advertising: spot, digital and podcast advertising sold to local and national advertisers; licensing or royalties: syndicated programming and network fees; other: live events, sponsorships and data services

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates radio stations and towers, delivering programming to listeners and ads to advertisers; software / platform: runs streaming app and podcast distribution platform serving listeners and advertisers; brand owner: produces and owns podcasts and content brands monetized via advertisers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; software / platform; brand owner

geography_served.value: US national: Radio stations in markets across the United States, with digital audio reaching listeners nationwide

specialization.value: related lines: broadcast radio, digital audio and podcasts, and networks, sponsorships and events, all audio advertising

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned AM/FM radio stations broadcasting over the air; online: streaming app, website, podcasts and smart speakers; direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to local and national advertisers; partners / resellers: programmatic ad platforms, syndication affiliates and third-party podcast platforms
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC licenses required for broadcast stations, ownership limits, content rules, music licensing and privacy rules
